# Source Node

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SourceNode`](gmeow-SourceNode.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SourceNode>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

A content-addressed node in a source graph — the common kind for all objects that participate in a versioned source tree (files, directories, and recursive tree structures). Aligned to the git object model and Software Heritage object graph by reference.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SourceNode`](gmeow-SourceNode.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
